title: Thoracic Ultrasound in the Treatment of Pleural Effusion
brief_summary: The main objective of the study is to assess the cost-effectiveness ratio of two management strategies of pleurisy in adults : a strategy by systematic thoracic ultrasound versus a strategy without thoracic ultrasound.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients hospitalized or seen in consultation with pleural effusion diagnosed clinically or radiologically whatever be its initial management.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with a neoplasia
